details: Role	: Sr. Power BI/Microsoft Fabric Developer					April 2024 – December 2024
Responsibilities:
Designed and developed interactive Power BI dashboards for financial analytics in the banking sector.
Utilized DAX and M formula for complex data modeling to provide insights into customer behavior and financial trends.
Developed a data warehouse solution using Microsoft Fabric that consolidated data from 50 sources, reducing data retrieval times by 40%
Spearheaded the migration of legacy data systems to Microsoft Fabric, resulting in a 30% increase in processing speed.
Designed custom dashboards and reports using Microsoft Fabric, providing stakeholders with actionable insights.
Implemented a Lakehouse with Microsoft Fabric for end to end Analytics
Organized and transformed data across Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers of a Lakehouse for optimized analytics in Microsoft Fabric
Use Azure Data Factory (ADF) to lift and shift SSIS packages to Azure, where they can be executed in an Azure-SSIS Integration Runtime.
Connect Azure Data Factory pipelines to Microsoft Fabric to enable data flow between on-premises data sources, cloud services, and Fabric's analytics environment.
Modify SSIS packages to interact directly with Fabric's data lakes, Synapse Analytics, or other Fabric components.
Integrated Azure Synapse, SQL, and Data Bricks for robust data warehousing solutions in banking.
Developed regular and ad-hoc financial reports for strategic planning in banking.
Led a team of BI developers in the banking sector, ensuring project alignment with business goals. Provided Power BI training and support to end-users in the banking industry.
Implemented data security measures in BI solutions to protect sensitive financial information.
Automated report generation for regulatory bodies using Power Automate.
Integrated Power Automate with multiple data sources, including SharePoint, Excel, and Azure SQL Database, to automate data collection and updates.
Implemented Azure Machine Learning models to enhance predictive analytics and business intelligence insights in the banking industry.
Utilized Python and Pandas to read large datasets from multiple file formats, including CSV, Excel, and JSON.
Performed data cleaning, filtering, aggregation, and merged datasets on common keys to ensure data consistency and accuracy.
Automated the ETL process and uploaded the final transformed datasets into Azure SQL Database for real-time analytics and reporting.

Environment – Power BI, DAX, Azure Storage, Azure Data Lake, Azure Databricks Lakehouse, Azure Synapse, Python, Power BI Gateway, Power Query, MS SQL Server 2016/2014/2012/2008 R2, MS Excel, Windows 8/10, Team Foundation, SSRS
